actions.lookup.description: Get information about CNAM, HLR, MNP, RCS capabilities and Number formats.
actions.lookup.props.numbers.description: The phone numbers to look up.
actions.send-rcs.description: Sends a Rich Communication Services message.
actions.send-rcs.props.delay.description: Date/time for delayed dispatch. Format: yyyy-mm-dd hh:ii or Unix timestamp.
actions.send-rcs.props.fallback.descript: Alternative channel if RCS is not available. If not specified, fallback is disabled.
actions.send-rcs.props.foreign_id.descri: Your own ID for this message (used in callbacks). Max 64 characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, .-_@).
actions.send-rcs.props.from.description: The unique ID of your RCS agent. If not specified, the first RCS-capable sender will be used.
actions.send-rcs.props.label.description: Label for statistics tracking. Max 100 characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, .-_@).
actions.send-rcs.props.performance_track: Activate click and performance tracking for URLs (also enables URL shortener).
actions.send-rcs.props.text.description: The body of the message to send.
actions.send-rcs.props.to.description: Recipient phone number for the RCS message (e.g., 49176123456789).
actions.send-rcs.props.ttl.description: Validity period of the RCS in minutes. Default is 2880 (48 hours).
actions.send-sms.description: Sends an SMS to one or more recipients.
actions.send-sms.props.text.description: The body of the message to send.
actions.send-voice-call.description: Creates a new Text-To-Speech call to a number.
actions.send-voice-call.props.text.descr: Text message to be read out.
actions.send-voice-call.props.to.descrip: Recipient number(s) of the voice calls.
auth.description: You can find your API key in [Developer Menu](https://app.seven.io/developer).
triggers.new_incoming_sms.description: Triggers when a new SMS message is received
triggers.new_incoming_sms.props.from.des: Optionally limit inbound SMS to this particular phone number.
